owner_rules.rule: Three consecutive merged PRs on one line that do not move the milestone headline force a pivot card.
A negative closes a configuration, never a mechanism. Decisive runs use >=2 seeds or >=200 fresh rows, train the mechanism in, and carry a TEST FITNESS: FIT review on the milestone before compute.
No softmax anywhere in the active project: training, serving, sampling, objectives, auxiliary losses, teachers, comparators. No table/renamed equivalent. Interlock scripts/check_no_softmax.py.
No CPU model compute; no GPU on work that cannot change a decision. A host-side fallback is a defect, not a cost to report.
No softplus, sigmoid or tanh anywhere: the scalar-activation carve-out is closed.

No matmul and no softmax anywhere, including GPU training: the owner ruled on 12 October 'no matmul at all anywhere, same with softmax - there is a ternary alternative with xor that may work'. The earlier conflict with agent-execution-policy.json is resolved by that ruling; the policy file's 'training may use matrix multiplication' sentence is stale and should be corrected.
owner_rules.source: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/issues/2029#issuecomment-6135511346; owner ruling recorded in DECISIONS.md D25 (harness session, 12 October 2026)

owner_rules.rule: OP1 runs the Hamilton rotation gate G2 only; the rectified-square arm G1 is withdrawn as non-geometric. A G2 miss closes that configuration only (D22); there is no non-geometric fallback.
The ban is on the dense SwiGLU MLP, not on a feed-forward block built from the project's geometry; a Hamilton gate plus Hamilton projections is acceptable.

The rules as of 2026-10-12 21:55 are the COMPLETE constraint set until the first compliant training run (rung 0 on the compliant trunk) reports. New concerns need a proposal card and take effect only after that run; cost or safety problems are the only exception. A result that needed softmax anywhere is not progress on any line.

Current geometric operator phase: OP2 first -> OP1 G2 only -> OP3a -> lawful rung0 after hold release -> OP4/rung0b; OP3b later research. Training and independent M2 rental hold remain. FIT lifts no hold; preserve peer work and frozen constraint set.

Ternary/XOR is an owner-suggested candidate replacement arithmetic, not an adopted mechanism and not yet shown to be geometric. It enters as a proposal under the D25 rule freeze; it is unimplemented, unmeasured and must pass a prospective TEST FITNESS review before any compute. See docs/mechanisms/ternary-xor-arithmetic.md.
